title: atoll balance --json
description: Each Atoll copy that breaks a strict setting of its file, by path in byte order, then by the position of its disk: the copy made where the setting wants it, and the old one sent to the trash as rebalance (specs.md §13.3). Exit 0 when each moved, and with --dry-run; 3 when there is something to move and no --yes; 4 when one stayed.

applied.description: Whether it was allowed to write: --yes.

bytes.description: The sizes of the files moved, or to move.

from.description: The disk of the copy that breaks the setting.

to.description: The disk of the copy made in its place; left out with no-target.

outcome.description: to-move without --yes; moved once the copy is made and the old one in the trash; no-target when no disk the setting allows has room; copied when the copy is made and the old one stays, as the plan still keeps it; or why the copy, or the old one's move to the trash, did not happen.
